skill.description: Research Xiaohongshu content topics through SocialDataX search, with sample collection, search filters, pagination, and evidence-based content angles.

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown formatting, ordinary service links, declared API-key usage, or an entropy heuristic on readable Chinese text. The CLI example downloads and executes an unpinned npm package, creating supply-chain exposure. A separate instruction requires sharing complete URLs containing xsec_token without redaction; no evidence of audit manipulation or deliberate credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: The CLI executes socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and integrity, and obtain permission before downloading or executing external code.

remediation.issue: The output rule requires preserving xsec_token in every display, storage operation, and forwarded URL.
remediation.suggestion: Keep full links only where necessary and authorized. Redact tokens in public output and logs, and obtain approval before sharing token-bearing URLs.

content.user_title: Analyze Xiaohongshu Topics and Content Angles
content.value_statement: Content teams need relevant Xiaohongshu samples before choosing topics. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes returned evidence into content angles and follow-up questions.
actual_capabilities: Guide keyword searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the xhs_search_notes MCP tool.
Specify sorting, content-type filters, and publication-time filters.
Collect multiple result pages with item limits and opaque continuation tokens.
Apply CLI recent-day filtering while stating the limits of retrieved coverage.
Organize returned titles, authors, identifiers, and source links into evidence and content-angle judgments.
Recover partial results while preserving cumulative page and item limits.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access and a configured API key; insufficient balance can prevent searches.
CLI execution requires Node.js, npm, network access, and an external package not bundled with this skill.
Search samples do not establish complete platform coverage or guarantee future content performance.
The workflow does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan Creator Topics
use_cases.description: Collect relevant samples for a niche, compare content angles, and identify follow-up questions before drafting.

use_cases.title: Research Brand Content
use_cases.description: Search a product category and separate observed topic patterns from proposed positioning ideas.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Editorial Opportunities
use_cases.description: Gather recent keyword results with fixed sample limits and summarize potential editorial directions.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one Xiaohongshu page for [topic]. Summarize relevant samples and three possible angles. Separate evidence from judgment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a small initial sample.

prompt_templates.title: Narrow the Audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] for [audience]. Limit collection to 20 image notes. Compare relevant titles and suggest focused content directions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [keyword] with CLI recent-day filtering for seven days, at most three pages and 40 items. State coverage limits and evidence-backed angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine time filters with collection limits.

prompt_templates.title: Resume Partial Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume this partial search using its original query and returned continuation token. Deduct collected pages and items from the original limits. Report remaining uncertainty.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover interrupted collection without restarting.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: explore small-apartment storage with one page of results.
output: Sample summary: organize returned titles, authors, and identifiers by storage problem.
Possible angle: compare renter-friendly approaches when supported by the retrieved samples.
Evidence boundary: one result page cannot establish platform-wide popularity.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize an interrupted recent-topic search.
output: Status: collection is incomplete; preserve the retrieved samples and error.
Recovery: resume with the returned continuation token and the remaining collection allowance.
Reporting: distinguish observed samples from proposed content directions.

best_practices: Start with one page and a focused keyword before expanding collection.
Use an approved, pinned CLI version and keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
Label evidence separately from interpretation and restrict token-bearing links to authorized recipients.
anti_patterns: Treating a limited search sample as complete platform coverage.
Restarting partial searches from the first page and ignoring cumulative collection limits.
Publishing API keys or token-bearing source URLs in public reports.

faq.question: What inputs does the skill accept?
faq.answer: Start with a keyword or topic direction. Add audience, content type, sorting, and time constraints when needed.

faq.question: Does it require a paid service?
faq.answer: It requires a SocialDataX API key and sufficient account balance. Pricing and available credits depend on the provider.

faq.question: Do I need an MCP server?
faq.answer: Not when your agent can run the CLI. The skill also documents the corresponding xhs_search_notes MCP tool.

faq.question: Can it publish or modify my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Are recent results complete?
faq.answer: No. Recent-day filtering applies within collected search pages. The skill warns against claiming complete platform coverage.

faq.question: What security precautions matter?
faq.answer: Approve a pinned CLI package before execution. Protect API keys and review token-bearing source links before sharing.
